spec.name: Orange Kitchen Calzone
spec.description: A plump golden half-moon calzone with a straight folded back, stepped domed crust, hand-pinched curved seam, toasted folds, and a small opening revealing tomato, melted cheese, and pepperoni. Grounded at y=0.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Calzone. Golden folded pastry with pinched edges, toasted crust, visible folds and appropriate filling hints. Actual recipe ingredients: dough, tomato sauce, cheese, pepperoni. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
